newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: WC Penfold to sell Penfold Printing stake.
newsitem.headline: WC Penfold to sell Penfold Printing stake.

text.p: W.C. Penfold Ltd said on Friday it will seek offers for its 54.4 percent shareholding in Penfold Printing Ltd as part of a major reconstruction of the W. C. Penfold group.

W.C. Penfold, a business supplies group, said it believed Penfold Printing would better serve its customers if it was part of a larger corporate group with a deeper institutional shareholder base better able to provide the capital necessary for further growth.
W.C. Penfold said it intended to return cash surplus to its operating requirements to its shareholders, probably by way of a reduction of capital.
"The amount of this reduction of capital will depend on whether W.C. Penfold sells its interest in Penfold Printing and the price it receives for its interst," W.C. Penfold said.
"W.C. Penfold is a genuine seller of its stake, but at the right price," W.C. Penfold chairman William Penfold said.
"We would prefer that any purchaser make a full bid for Penfold Printing so that all Penfold Printing shareholders, not just W.C. Penfold, can participate," Penfold said.
He said in a statement the reconstruction of the group would enable W.C. Penfold to focus on its stationery business.
W.C. Penfold shares were untraded at the midsession on Friday, after having closed steady at A$2.10 on Thursday.
Penfold Printing shares were untraded from their last close at A$1.12 on April 15. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
